# The Lollipop Coop

> The Lollipop Coop is a food trailer in Orlando, Florida that serves lollipop chicken: whole chicken drumsticks trimmed so the meat sits at the top and the clean bone works as a handle. We serve breweries, festivals, markets, pop-ups, and private and corporate events across Orlando and Central Florida.

## About
- Founded by Mike and Melissa in Orlando, FL.
- Started because wings felt too small for the price; lollipop drums are a bigger, meatier bite.
- Rock Pit Brewing was the first brewery to host the trailer.

## Menu
- Lollipop Chicken Drums (signature): each drum is fried and dipped in the sauce of your choice, including buffalo, mango habanero, hot honey, and teriyaki.
- Philly Fries
- Coop Toston
- Mac & Cheese Balls
- Mozzarella Sticks
- Fries and rotating sides
- Menu can vary by event.

## Where to find us
- Breweries, festivals, markets, and pop-ups around Orlando and Central Florida.
- Schedule changes weekly and is posted on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the_lollipop_coop/

## Booking
- Private and corporate events (company lunches, team events, birthday parties, grand openings, neighborhood gatherings): https://thelollipopcoop.com/#contact — replies within 24 hours.
- Breweries and venues can also book us through RosterFlip: https://rosterflip.com
- Service area: Orlando and the greater Central Florida area.
